Keep original lean starter outfit, green short cloak/ivory trim, iron breastplate, plain leather belt, fitted charcoal trousers, brown closed gloves and boots, high dark collar covers neck, fully covered skin. Never add ornate premium armor. Cloth folds, seams, leather buckle/edge, metal highlights, eyes and hair use clean precise pixel clusters. No smearing or soft painting.
